(6)  While ordinarily, for the institution of non-conviction
based forfeiture proceedings, a judicial freezing order shall
be a prerequisite, if the Attorney-General can establish that
for  reasons  beyond  the  control  of  the  relevant  Designated
Officer or Investigation Officer, it was not possible to obtain
a  judicial  freezing  order,  he  shall  be  entitled  to  institute
proceedings for non-conviction based forfeiture even in the
absence of a judicial freezing order.
